run.objective: Convert the v8.2 loop-quality hardening contract into an executable quality-gate plan before any source patch proposal.

gates.purpose: Detect whether validation commands leave generated artifacts dirty without being declared outputs.
gates.proposedCheck: Capture git status before and after validation, then classify generated artifact drift.

gates.purpose: Distinguish timestamp-only rewrites from semantic artifact changes.
gates.proposedCheck: Inspect changed JSON/Markdown artifacts for generatedAt-only or timestamp-only diffs.

gates.purpose: Prevent apply steps from claiming meaningful source changes when only metadata changed or no diff exists.
gates.proposedCheck: Require patch reports to expose applied, changed, diffOutput, and semanticChange fields.

gates.purpose: Preserve the line between workflow preparation and operator GitHub actions.
gates.proposedCheck: Assert no branch push, PR open, merge, or destructive git operation occurs inside workflow scripts.

gates.purpose: Ensure source edits stay inside the active contract or approval artifact target list.
gates.proposedCheck: Compare changed paths against the contract's allowedTargets list.

notes: This turns the v8.2 loop-quality contract into a concrete gate plan.
It does not generate or apply a source patch.
The next safe step is v8.4 implementation intent for these quality gates.
